🔬 Science Basics科学基本概念

Qualitative, quantitative, observation & interpretation定性、定量、观察与解释

Your lab partner writes "the reaction is exothermic" under Observations. On this test that line loses marks — it is an interpretation. Knowing which box each sentence belongs in is free marks.实验搭档在「观察」一栏写了「这个反应是放热反应」。考试里这句会被扣分——它是解释，不是观察。分清每句话该放哪一栏，就是白拿的分。

Difficulty难度 ●○○
⏱ 25 min · ★ essential必会

🔑 Must know必须记住 · Qualitative, quantitative, observation & interpretation定性、定量、观察与解释
  1. Qualitative = senses, no numbers. Quantitative = measured or counted numbers.定性＝感官，无数字。定量＝测量或计数的数字。
  2. Observation = qualitative, sensed directly. Interpretation = what it means, not directly seen.观察＝定性、直接感知。解释＝它意味着什么，看不见。
  3. Description = properties in words and numbers, so it can be both.描述＝用文字和数字列性质，可以两者兼有。
Observation 观察
👀 seen, heard, smelled, felt 用感官得到
e.g. bubbles formed 例：冒出气泡
heat was released 放出了热量
vs
Interpretation 解释
💭 explains what it means 解释它意味着什么
e.g. a gas was produced 例：生成了气体
the reaction is exothermic 反应放热

Qualitative vs quantitative定性与定量

Qualitative 定性
🎨 words, no numbers 用文字描述，没有数字
the solution is blue 溶液是蓝色
the metal is shiny 金属有光泽
vs
Quantitative 定量
🔢 numbers and units 有数字和单位
mass is 12.5 g 质量是 12.5 g
temperature rose by 8 °C 温度升高了 8 °C

🧗 The hard part难点 · Qualitative, quantitative, observation & interpretation定性、定量、观察与解释

Splitting one sentence into observation + interpretation把一句话拆成观察＋解释

Real sentences mix what was sensed and what was concluded.真实句子里「感觉到的」和「推断出的」混在一起。

  1. Cut the sentence at "so" / "because".在「所以／因为」处切开。
  2. For each piece: could I see, hear, smell or feel it? Yes → observation.每一段问：能看到、听到、闻到、摸到吗？能→观察。
  3. Needs a chemistry idea (reaction, exothermic, gas name)? → interpretation.需要化学概念（反应、放热、气体名称）？→解释。
Try试一试
Split: "The test tube got hot, so the reaction is exothermic."拆分：「试管变热了，所以反应是放热的。」
Answer答案
Observation: the test tube got hot. Interpretation: the reaction is exothermic.观察：试管变热。解释：反应是放热的。

⚠️ Traps & tip陷阱与提示 · Qualitative, quantitative, observation & interpretation定性、定量、观察与解释
  • "4 beakers" is qualitative → it is a count, so quantitative.「4 个烧杯」是定性 → 计数，是定量。
  • "A gas was produced" is an observation → interpretation; "bubbles formed" is the observation.「产生了气体」是观察 → 是解释；「出现气泡」才是观察。
🟡
Your class notes say an observation must be qualitative (measurements count as quantitative data, not observations). Many textbooks call measurements "quantitative observations". On this test use the class version: observation = qualitative.课堂讲义规定观察必须是定性的（测量得到的数字算定量数据，不算观察）。很多教材把测量叫作「定量观察」。考试按讲义：观察＝定性。
🎯
Circle numbers first; then split sentences at "so" or "because".先圈数字；再在「所以／因为」处拆句。

🔬 Science Basics科学基本概念

Data, experiment, hypothesis, theory & law数据、实验、假设、理论与定律

Mass before a reaction: 45.6 g. Mass after: 45.6 g. Is that a hypothesis, data, a theory or a law? The test asks exactly this — and "law" and "theory" are the pair everyone mixes up.反应前质量 45.6 g，反应后 45.6 g。这是假设、数据、理论还是定律？考试就考这个——而「定律」和「理论」是最容易搞混的一对。

Difficulty难度 ●●○
⏱ 25 min · ★ essential必会

🔑 Must know必须记住 · Data, experiment, hypothesis, theory & law数据、实验、假设、理论与定律
  1. Data = numbers from an experiment; it supports or does not support a hypothesis, never proves it.数据＝实验得到的数字；只支持或不支持假设，不能证明。
  2. Hypothesis = one unproven, testable guess ("If…, then…"). Experiment = test that gives a result.假设＝单一、未证实、可检验的猜测（如果……那么……）。实验＝得出结果的测试。
  3. Theory explains WHY and can change. Law describes WHAT, does not explain, often an equation.理论解释为什么、可修改。定律描述是什么、不解释、常写成等式。

🖼️ Picture it看图理解 · Data, experiment, hypothesis, theory & law数据、实验、假设、理论与定律
  • How science builds ideas科学怎样建立观点
    • Hypothesis假设one unproven, testable guess单一、未证实、可检验的猜测
      • Experiment实验test or procedure → result测试或步骤→结果
        • Data数据numbers · support or not support数字 · 支持或不支持
    • Theory理论explains WHY · can change解释「为什么」· 可修改
    • Law定律describes WHAT · does not explain描述「是什么」· 不解释

🖼️ Picture it看图理解 · Data, experiment, hypothesis, theory & law数据、实验、假设、理论与定律

Theory vs law理论与定律

Theory 理论
💡 explains WHY 解释为什么
built from many tested hypotheses 由许多检验过的假设建立
e.g. Cell Theory 例：细胞学说
vs
Law 定律
📏 describes WHAT happens 描述发生了什么
does not explain why 不解释原因
often an equation 常写成等式，例：质量守恒定律

🧗 The hard part难点 · Data, experiment, hypothesis, theory & law数据、实验、假设、理论与定律

Theory vs law理论与定律

Both are backed by many experiments, so "how well tested" cannot tell them apart.两者都有大量实验支持，所以不能靠「检验得多不多」来区分。

  1. Does it give a reason (particles, cells, why)? → theory.有没有给出原因（粒子、细胞、为什么）？→理论。
  2. Does it only state a pattern or equation (before = after)? → law.只陈述规律或等式（前＝后）？→定律。
Try试一试
"The pressure of a gas doubles when its volume is halved (temperature constant)." Theory or law?「温度不变时，气体体积减半，压强加倍。」理论还是定律？
Answer答案
Law — it describes a pattern (PV stays constant) without explaining why.定律——它描述规律（PV 不变），不解释原因。

⚠️ Traps & tip陷阱与提示 · Data, experiment, hypothesis, theory & law数据、实验、假设、理论与定律
  • "The data proves the hypothesis" → "the data supports the hypothesis".「数据证明了假设」→「数据支持了假设」。
  • "A theory becomes a law when proven" → they never convert; why vs what.「理论被证明后变成定律」→ 两者不会转化；为什么 vs 是什么。
🟡
Your class notes define data as quantitative only (numbers from an experiment); many textbooks also allow qualitative data. The notes also say data supports or does not support a hypothesis and does not prove it — on this test write "supports", never "proves".课堂讲义把数据定义为只含定量信息（实验得到的数字）；很多教材也承认定性数据。讲义还强调数据只能支持或不支持假设，不能证明它——考试写「支持」，不要写「证明」。
🎯
Theory vs law: look for "explains", "because", "why".理论还是定律：找「解释」「因为」「为什么」。

quiz.q: Qualitative or quantitative: "The flame turned bright orange."定性还是定量：「火焰变成了亮橙色。」
quiz.a: Qualitative定性
quiz.sol: • Colour is seen with your eyes and has no number → qualitative.颜色用眼睛看，没有数字→定性。
quiz.goal: Identify a qualitative statement.识别定性说法。
quiz.idea: Colour, no number.颜色，没有数字。

quiz.q: Qualitative or quantitative: "The solution reached 37.5 °C."定性还是定量：「溶液温度达到 37.5 °C。」
c: Qualitative定性
Quantitative定量
Observation观察
Interpretation解释
quiz.a: Quantitative定量
quiz.sol: • 37.5 °C is a measured number → quantitative.37.5 °C 是测量出的数字→定量。
quiz.goal: Identify a quantitative statement.识别定量说法。
quiz.idea: A thermometer reading is a number.温度计读数是数字。

quiz.q: Observation or interpretation: "A popping sound was heard when the splint was lit."观察还是解释：「点燃木条时听到『噗』的一声。」
quiz.a: Observation观察
quiz.sol: • The sound is heard directly → observation (qualitative).声音是直接听到的→观察（定性）。
quiz.goal: Recognise an observation made by hearing.认出靠听觉得到的观察。
quiz.idea: Hearing is a sense; nothing is being explained.听觉是感官；这里没有解释任何东西。

quiz.q: In "The liquid turned cloudy, so a precipitate formed", which part is the interpretation?在「液体变浑浊了，所以生成了沉淀」中，哪一部分是解释？
quiz.a: "A precipitate formed" is the interpretation; "turned cloudy" is the observation.「生成了沉淀」是解释；「变浑浊」是观察。
quiz.sol:
• "Turned cloudy" — seen → observation.「变浑浊」——看得到→观察。
  • "A precipitate formed" — a conclusion about what the cloudiness is → interpretation.「生成了沉淀」——对浑浊原因的结论→解释。
quiz.goal: Find the interpretation inside a cause-and-effect sentence.在因果句里找出解释部分。
quiz.idea: Cloudy is seen; "a precipitate formed" is what we think it means.浑浊是看到的；「生成沉淀」是我们对它的理解。

quiz.q: Which statement is an interpretation?哪一句是解释？
c: The gas has no smell这种气体没有气味
The metal is shiny这种金属有光泽
Carbon dioxide gas was produced产生了二氧化碳气体
Fizzing was heard听到了嘶嘶声
quiz.a: Carbon dioxide gas was produced产生了二氧化碳气体
quiz.sol:
• Smell, shine and sound are sensed directly → observations.气味、光泽、声音是直接感知的→观察。
  • Naming the gas as COX2​ is a conclusion → interpretation.判断气体是 COX2​ 是一个结论→解释。
quiz.goal: Pick the statement that names something not directly sensed.挑出说出了看不见的东西的那句。
quiz.idea: You can see bubbles, but you cannot see that the gas is carbon dioxide.气泡看得见，但看不出那是二氧化碳。

quiz.q: Is "The copper wire is reddish-brown and 15.0 cm long" an observation or a description? Explain in one sentence.「铜丝是红棕色的，长 15.0 cm」是观察还是描述？用一句话说明。
quiz.a: Description — it lists properties with both words (reddish-brown) and a number (15.0 cm); an observation must be qualitative only.描述——它同时用文字（红棕色）和数字（15.0 cm）列出性质；观察只能是定性的。
quiz.sol:
• Colour = qualitative, 15.0 cm = quantitative → both.颜色＝定性，15.0 cm＝定量→两者都有。
  • Only a description can be both → description.只有描述能两者兼有→描述。
quiz.goal: Use the class rule that observations are qualitative to classify a mixed statement.用「观察只能定性」这条规则给混合说法归类。
quiz.idea: It contains a number, so it cannot be an observation in this class.含有数字，按本课规定就不能是观察。

quiz.q: Rewrite "The reaction is endothermic" as an observation a student could actually make.把「这个反应是吸热反应」改写成学生真正能观察到的一句话。
quiz.a: For example: "The beaker felt cold to the touch." (no numbers, only senses)例如：「烧杯摸起来变凉了。」（无数字，只用感官）
quiz.sol:
• "Endothermic" is an interpretation.「吸热反应」是解释。
  • The evidence is that the container feels cold → that is the observation. Do not add a thermometer reading, or it becomes quantitative.证据是容器摸起来变凉→这才是观察。不要加温度计读数，否则就成了定量。
quiz.goal: Turn an interpretation back into the sensed evidence behind it.把解释还原成背后能感知的证据。
quiz.idea: Endothermic means heat is taken in — what would you feel?吸热意味着吸收热量——你会摸到什么？

quiz.q: A lab report says: (1) "The mass of the beaker was 80.0 g." (2) "The solution smelled sour." (3) "The solution is acidic because it smelled sour." (4) "The liquid is clear and has a volume of 25 mL." Label each: observation, interpretation, description, or quantitative (not an observation).实验报告写道：(1)「烧杯质量为 80.0 g。」(2)「溶液闻起来酸酸的。」(3)「因为闻起来酸，所以溶液是酸性的。」(4)「液体澄清，体积 25 mL。」给每句贴标签：观察、解释、描述，还是定量（不算观察）。
quiz.a: (1) quantitative (a measurement — data, not an observation); (2) observation; (3) interpretation; (4) description.(1) 定量（测量值——是数据，不是观察）；(2) 观察；(3) 解释；(4) 描述。
quiz.sol:
• (1) 80.0 g is a measurement → quantitative.(1) 80.0 g 是测量值→定量。
  • (2) Smell only → observation.(2) 只有气味→观察。
  • (3) "Acidic because…" explains the smell → interpretation.(3) 「因为……所以是酸性」在解释气味→解释。
  • (4) Clear (word) + 25 mL (number) listing properties → description.(4) 澄清（文字）＋25 mL（数字）列出性质→描述。
quiz.goal: Sort real lab-report sentences using all four ideas at once.综合四个概念给真实实验报告里的句子归类。
quiz.idea: Number only → quantitative; senses only → observation; explains → interpretation; words + numbers listing properties → description.只有数字→定量；只靠感官→观察；在解释→解释；文字加数字列性质→描述。

quiz.q: Which scientific term: a single, unproven, testable guess about what an experiment will show?哪个科学术语：对实验结果的一个单一、未证实、可检验的猜测？
quiz.a: Hypothesis假设
quiz.sol: • An untested educated guess is a hypothesis.未经检验的有根据猜测就是假设。
quiz.goal: Recall the definition of hypothesis.回忆「假设」的定义。
quiz.idea: Single + unproven + testable = hypothesis.单一＋未证实＋可检验＝假设。

quiz.q: Theory or law: it describes what happens in nature but does not explain why?理论还是定律：只描述自然界发生了什么，但不解释原因？
quiz.a: Law定律
quiz.sol: • Describing without explaining is what a law does.只描述不解释，这是定律。
quiz.goal: Recall that a law describes and does not explain.回忆定律只描述、不解释。
quiz.idea: What = law; why = theory.是什么＝定律；为什么＝理论。

quiz.q: "Comparing how fast a sugar cube dissolves in 10 °C water and in 60 °C water." What is this?「比较方糖在 10 °C 水和 60 °C 水中溶解的快慢。」这是什么？
quiz.a: An experiment实验
quiz.sol: • A test or procedure performed to discover a result → experiment.为发现结果而进行的测试或步骤→实验。
quiz.goal: Recognise a procedure as an experiment.把一套操作认作实验。
quiz.idea: It is something you do to get a result.这是为得到结果而去做的事。

quiz.q: Which one is data?哪一项是数据？
c: If plants get more light, they grow taller如果植物得到更多光照，就会长得更高
The plant grew 3.2 cm in one week植株一周长高了 3.2 cm
All living things are made of cells一切生物都由细胞构成
The leaves looked greener叶子看起来更绿了
quiz.a: The plant grew 3.2 cm in one week植株一周长高了 3.2 cm
quiz.sol: • A = hypothesis, C = part of Cell Theory, D = qualitative observation. Only B is a measured number → data.A＝假设，C＝细胞学说的内容，D＝定性观察。只有 B 是测量出的数字→数据。
quiz.goal: Pick the quantitative experimental result.选出实验得到的定量结果。
quiz.idea: Data in this class = numbers from an experiment.本课的数据＝实验得到的数字。

quiz.q: Rewrite this question as a testable hypothesis: "Does stirring change how fast salt dissolves?"把这个问题改写成可检验的假设：「搅拌会改变盐溶解的快慢吗？」
quiz.a: If the salt water is stirred, then the salt will dissolve faster.如果搅拌盐水，那么盐会溶解得更快。
quiz.sol:
• Change: stirring. Prediction: dissolves faster. Put them in If-then form.改变的因素：搅拌。预测：溶得更快。放进「如果—那么」句式。
  • It is a single, testable guess — it can be supported or rejected by timing the dissolving.它是单一、可检验的猜测——计时就能支持或否定它。
quiz.goal: Write a hypothesis in If-then form.用「如果……那么……」写出假设。
quiz.idea: If (what you change), then (what you predict will happen).如果（你改变的因素），那么（你预测的结果）。

quiz.q: Theory or law? "Gas particles move faster when heated, which is why a heated balloon expands."理论还是定律？「气体粒子受热后运动更快，这就是受热气球会膨胀的原因。」
c: Law, because it is supported by many experiments定律，因为有许多实验支持
Theory, because it explains why理论，因为它解释了原因
Hypothesis, because it uses "when"假设，因为用了「当……时」
Data, because it is about a balloon数据，因为讲的是气球
quiz.a: Theory — it explains why the balloon expands.理论——它解释了气球为什么膨胀。
quiz.sol:
• "Many experiments" fits both theories and laws, so A is not a reason.「许多实验」理论和定律都符合，所以 A 不成立。
  • It gives the reason (particles move faster) → theory.它给出了原因（粒子运动更快）→理论。
quiz.goal: Decide theory vs law by whether the statement explains.按是否在解释来判断理论还是定律。
quiz.idea: Both theories and laws are supported by many experiments; the difference is explain vs describe.理论和定律都有大量实验支持；区别在于解释还是描述。

quiz.q: A student hypothesises: "If water is warmer, then sugar dissolves faster." Times: 120 s at 20 °C, 75 s at 40 °C, 48 s at 60 °C. Does the data support the hypothesis? Can she say it is proven?学生假设：「如果水更热，糖就溶得更快。」计时：20 °C 时 120 s，40 °C 时 75 s，60 °C 时 48 s。数据支持这个假设吗？她能说假设被证明了吗？
quiz.a: Yes, it supports the hypothesis (times fall 120 → 75 → 48 s as water warms). No, it is not proven — data only supports.支持（水越热，时间从 120 → 75 → 48 s 下降）。不能说被证明——数据只能支持。
quiz.sol:
• 120>75>48: warmer water, less time → faster dissolving. Supports.120>75>48：水越热用时越少→溶得越快。支持。
  • One set of data supports it; it does not prove it.一组数据只能支持，不能证明。
quiz.goal: Read data against a hypothesis and use "support", not "prove".用数据检验假设，并用「支持」而不是「证明」。
quiz.idea: Shorter time = faster dissolving. Times drop as temperature rises.时间越短＝溶得越快。温度升高，时间下降。

quiz.q: A friend says: "Cell Theory is just a theory, so it is weaker than a law and will become a law once it is proven." Give two reasons this is wrong, using the class definitions.朋友说：「细胞学说只是理论，比定律弱，等被证明了就会变成定律。」用讲义的定义说出两个错误之处。
quiz.a: (1) A theory is not a weak guess: it is tested, refined and supported by many experiments. (2) A theory never turns into a law: a theory explains why, a law only describes what happens. (Also, science does not "prove" — evidence supports.)(1) 理论不是弱的猜测：它经过检验、修正，有许多实验支持。(2) 理论不会变成定律：理论解释为什么，定律只描述发生什么。（另外，科学不说「证明」——证据只是支持。）
quiz.sol:
• A "just a guess" is a hypothesis; a theory is built from many tested hypotheses.「只是猜测」的是假设；理论由许多经过检验的假设构成。
  • Cell Theory explains why (cells are the basic unit of life). A law would only describe a pattern, so the two do not convert into each other.细胞学说解释原因（细胞是生命的基本单位）。定律只描述规律，所以两者不会互相转化。
quiz.goal: Argue about the nature of theories and laws using definitions.用定义论证理论与定律的本质。
quiz.idea: Theories and laws do different jobs; neither turns into the other, and theories are built on many experiments.理论和定律分工不同，不会互相转化；理论建立在大量实验之上。

diag.q: Which statement is quantitative?哪一句是定量的？
c: The rock feels rough岩石摸起来粗糙
Five crystals formed in the dish培养皿里长出了五颗晶体
The solution smells sweet溶液闻起来是甜的
The gas is colourless气体是无色的
why: Touch only, no number — qualitative.只有触觉、没有数字——定性。
Correct: counting five crystals gives a number, so it is quantitative.正确：数出五颗晶体得到一个数字，所以是定量。
Smell is a sense with no number — qualitative.气味是感官、没有数字——定性。
Colour (even "no colour") is qualitative.颜色（包括「无色」）是定性。
diag.goal: Spot that a count is quantitative.看出计数属于定量。
diag.idea: Any number, measured or counted, makes it quantitative.任何数字，无论测量还是计数，都使之成为定量。

diag.q: A student writes: "The mixture turned blue and got warm, so copper ions formed." Which part is an interpretation?学生写道：「混合物变蓝并变热，所以生成了铜离子。」哪一部分是解释？
c: "turned blue"「变蓝」
"got warm"「变热」
"copper ions formed"「生成了铜离子」
All three are observations三者都是观察
why: Colour is seen directly — observation.颜色是直接看到的——观察。
Warmth is felt directly — observation (heat felt is an observation in this class).变热是直接摸到的——观察（本课把感到热算作观察）。
Correct: you cannot see ions; naming them explains the colour → interpretation.正确：离子看不见；说出离子是在解释颜色→解释。
Confuses evidence with the conclusion drawn from it.把证据和由证据得出的结论混为一谈。
diag.goal: Separate sensed evidence from a particle-level conclusion.把感知到的证据与微观层面的结论分开。
diag.idea: Particles (ions, atoms) are never directly seen in a school lab.在学校实验室里，粒子（离子、原子）永远看不见。

diag.q: Which is a hypothesis?哪一项是假设？
c: The beaker has a mass of 52.1 g烧杯质量 52.1 g
Mass is conserved in a chemical reaction化学反应中质量守恒
If the paper towel is thicker, then it will absorb more water如果纸巾更厚，那么它会吸更多水
All matter is made of atoms that explain chemical change一切物质由原子构成，这解释了化学变化
why: A measured number is data, not a guess.测量出的数字是数据，不是猜测。
A well-established pattern stated without a reason is a law.不讲原因、已被反复确认的规律是定律。
Correct: a single, testable, unproven If-then prediction.正确：一个单一、可检验、未证实的「如果—那么」预测。
An explanation built from many experiments is a theory, not a hypothesis.由大量实验建立的解释是理论，不是假设。
diag.goal: Tell a hypothesis apart from data, a law and a theory.把假设与数据、定律、理论区分开。
diag.idea: Untested + testable prediction = hypothesis.未检验＋可检验的预测＝假设。

diag.q: An experiment gives data that disagrees with a hypothesis. What is the best conclusion?实验数据与假设不符。最好的结论是什么？
c: The hypothesis is not supported假设不被支持
The data is wrong because hypotheses are proven数据错了，因为假设已被证明
The hypothesis becomes a theory假设变成理论
The hypothesis becomes a law假设变成定律
why: Correct: data can fail to support (reject) a hypothesis.正确：数据可以不支持（否定）假设。
A hypothesis is unproven by definition — the data is how it gets tested.假设按定义就是未证实的——数据正是用来检验它的。
A theory is built from many supported hypotheses, not a rejected one.理论由许多被支持的假设构成，不是由被否定的假设变成的。
A law describes a well-established pattern; a failed guess is not a law.定律描述已被确认的规律；失败的猜测不是定律。
diag.goal: Apply "support / not support" to data that disagrees.对不符合的数据运用「支持／不支持」。
diag.idea: Data either supports or does not support the hypothesis.数据要么支持假设，要么不支持。
